mapper.select: SELECT id, attempt_id, task_id, attempt_no, trigger_type, attempt_status, stage, context_json, publish_request_json, publish_result_json, error_code, error_message, retryable, cost_amount, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}

SELECT id, attempt_id, task_id, attempt_no, trigger_type, attempt_status, stage, error_code, error_message, retryable, cost_amount, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_attempt WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS attempt_count, COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) AS max_attempt_no, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms < 0 THEN 0 ELSE duration_ms END), 0) AS total_duration_ms, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cost_amount, 0)), 0) AS total_cost_amount FROM ai_xhs_publish_attempt WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, attempt_id, task_id, attempt_no, trigger_type, attempt_status, stage, context_json, publish_request_json, publish_result_json, error_code, error_message, retryable, cost_amount, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_attempt WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_xhs_publish_attempt ( attempt_id, task_id, attempt_no, trigger_type, attempt_status, stage, context_json, publish_request_json, publish_result_json, error_code, error_message, retryable, cost_amount, start_time, end_time, duration_ms) VALUES ( #{attemptId}, #{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{triggerType}, #{attemptStatus}, #{stage}, #{contextJson}, #{publishRequestJson}, #{publishResultJson}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryable}, #{costAmount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMs})
